messages:
maeve (eng-platform): Heads up — started seeing missing trace context when requests go gateway -> sqs delay -> worker. Root span is there but child spans from worker are disconnected. Happening on ~0.3% of delayed jobs.

ravi (eng-runtime): Interesting. Are we using message attributes to carry context or inlined headers? SQS size limits could truncate baggage.

maeve (eng-platform): We put a base64 blob in message attribute X-Redwood-Trace. Payload looks like a packed OTEL context + baggage. Suspect long user-level baggage sometimes pushes it over and SQS silently drops.

sasha (eng-ml): Can we drop non-essential baggage? For model eval workloads we attach prompt hashes and eval ids — maybe only need trace-id + sampled flag + span-id for stitching. :thinking_face:

luis (eng-infra): Also worth noting SNS/SQS can truncate or fail on attributes > 10KB. We should log attribute sizes on enqueue. Quick mitigation: switch to a compact carrier that is deterministic and <= 1KB.

maeve (eng-platform): Agreed. Proposal: change carrier to compact hex of traceparent + minimal baggage keys (env, customer_id truncated). Add an async rehydrate service for large carriers that stores full baggage in dynamo and puts a small lookup token in SQS.

ravi (eng-runtime): Sounds ok. Two implementation notes:
- runtime should accept both full X-Redwood-Trace and the lookup token (backwards compat)
- worker should try to rehydrate on start; if rehydrate fails, still attach incoming traceparent as parent and emit a warning metric.

ravi (eng-runtime): Example attr mapping we can ship:
```
MessageAttributes:{
  "x-rd-tp": { StringValue: "traceparent-hex" },
  "x-rd-rt": { StringValue: "rehydrate-token" } // optional
}
```
keep everything under 2kb.

sasha (eng-ml): Also adjust sampling: if trace came through rehydrate token, mark high-priority sampling to avoid losing telemetry for replays.

luis (eng-infra): I'll add an exporter check: if we see many orphan spans for the same trace-id, alert and include enqueue attribute sizes in the alert payload.

maeve (eng-platform): Great. Action items: luis add metric + alert (P1), ravi implement dual-carrier parsing + fallback (P1), sasha prune eval baggage + update sampling (P2), i'll spec rehydrate service + small token format (P1). I'll open PRs and drop links here.

opsbot: deploybot: rollout started for eng-runtime/trace-carrier-compact v1 -> staging :rocket:

maeve (eng-platform): Thx — will monitor traces in datadog and the new orphan-span alert. If anyone sees regression ping me directly.
